Karla (CS): hey team — i'm jumping on Evan's accounts today. need HubSpot seats + Dialpad access and the latest CS<>Sales handoff playbook. who should i ping for seat requests? cc @Evan
Evan (Sales): welcome Karla! :tada: i'll DM you the initial account list and priority flags. for seats ping Priya in IT. quick checklist: HubSpot license (support role), Dialpad seat + softphone, Gong access if you're listening to demos.
Karla (CS): got it — for HubSpot is 'support' enough or do i need a sales-licensed seat to log notes?
Priya (IT): hi Karla — for CS we give the 'Support User' role by default; that includes write access on tickets/contacts. process: open a ticket at https://tickets.redwood.ai/new or run the internal slash command. example:
```
/seat-request --product hubspot --role support_user --user karla@redwood.ai --reason "CS onboarding demo support"
```
For Dialpad run:
```
/seat-request --product dialpad --seat-type softphone --user karla@redwood.ai
```
If you need a physical headset, note that in the ticket and ops will route one.
Evan (Sales): also add Gong Listen access — i'll share the specific folders and sequences.
Jules (Ops): FYI the handoff playbook is at https://drive.redwood.ai/CS-Sales/handbook/onboarding_v2.pdf — see the 'Handoffs' and 'Call Scripts' sections. we updated the objection-handling bullets last week.
onboarding-bot: Ticket #4567 created for Karla: HubSpot + Dialpad seats (ETA: 1 business day).
Karla (CS): perfect, thanks — can we schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to go through priority accounts and the handoff flow? i'm free 10:00–11:00 PT.
Evan (Sales): 10:30 works for me, invite sent. i'll bring the account notes and demo recordings. tagging Ben for visibility.
Ben (CS Manager): welcome Karla! glad to have you. once seats are in place let's pair on the first three accounts — i'll join the sync and help with escalation contacts.
Karla (CS): received the invite. one more q — is there a prebuilt initial outreach email template for CS to use in Gong sequences? want to plug it in asap.
Jules (Ops): templates live in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CS/Templates — if you want i can paste the 'Initial Touch' template here.
Evan (Sales): i'll DM you the Gong sequence id and the demo snippets to include.
Karla (CS): awesome, thanks everyone :seedling:
